map.NICHQ Vanderbilt ADHD Diagnostic Rating: NICHQ Vanderbilt ADHD Diagnostic Rating Scale: assess ADHD symptoms and behavioral comorbidity in 6-18 yr children
map.提示：评分0=从不,1=偶尔,2=常如此,3=很常如此,4=非常频繁。ADHD诊: Note: scores 0=never,1=occasionally,2=often,3=very often,4=very frequently. ADHD diagnosis needs: inattention OR hyperactivity/impulsivity ≥6 items scored ≥2, onset before age 12, persistent ≥6 months, across settings (home+school), impairing function. Both parent and teacher scales positive. Exclude hyperthyroidism, sleep disorder, vision/hearing impairment etc. Treatment: behavioral therapy + medication (methylphenidate/atomoxetine). This is a screening tool; diagnosis needs specialist.
map.ADHD 需多场景表现，单场景阳性可能为情境性行为。: ADHD needs multi-setting presentation; single-setting positive may be situational.
map.多动症(Vanderbilt)量表评估器，NICHQ Vanderbilt量表评: The ADHD (Vanderbilt) scale assessor uses the NICHQ Vanderbilt scale to assess child ADHD symptoms and comorbid behavior problems. A medical professional tool based on authoritative standards, for reference only.
map.共病筛查（本页未含品行障碍 14 条）: Comorbidity screen (the 14 conduct-disorder items are not included)
map.提示：症状题评分0=从不,1=偶尔,2=常如此,3=很常如此；功能题0=有问题~: Note: symptom items are scored 0=never, 1=occasionally, 2=often, 3=very often; function items 0=problem to 4=excellent. ADHD diagnosis requires ≥6 items scored ≥2 in inattention or hyperactivity-impulsivity, onset before age 12, duration ≥6 months, cross-setting presentation and functional impairment. Comorbidity screens: ≥4 of 8 ODD items and ≥3 of 7 anxiety/depression items scored ≥2 are positive. Both parent and teacher forms should be positive. Rule out hyperthyroidism, sleep disorders, and visual/hearing impairment. Treatment: behavioral therapy plus medication (methylphenidate/atomoxetine). This is a screening tool; diagnosis requires specialist assessment.
map.行为/对立违抗（ODD）8 条中 ≥4 条评分≥2，或焦虑/抑郁 7 条中 ≥3: Four or more of the 8 ODD items, or three or more of the 7 anxiety/depression items, scored ≥2 → positive comorbidity screen; provide combined intervention.
map.注意或多动维度各需 ≥6 条评分≥2；ODD 需 ≥4/8 条评分≥2，焦虑/抑: At least 6 of 9 items scored ≥2 in inattention or hyperactivity-impulsivity; ODD requires ≥4 of 8 and anxiety/depression ≥3 of 7 items scored ≥2; plus cross-setting information (parent and teacher), age ≥6 years, and functional impairment before ADHD is suspected.
map.注意缺陷维度≥6 项评分≥2（0–3 分制）→注意缺陷型阳性，需教师版交叉。: At least 6 inattention items scored ≥2 (0–3 scale) → inattentive type positive; cross-check with the teacher form.
